description: This file is a CMake script that locates and sets up the Protobuf library and related tools for the build system, configuring either modern or traditional target methods depending on availability.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates the Protobuf package either via CONFIG or MODULE mode.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target for protobuf or protobuf-lite.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on target libraries, such as include directories and imported locations.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Sets properties on targets, such as imported locations for different configurations.

methods.name: add_executable
methods.description: Defines an imported executable target for protobuf's protoc compiler.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status, warning, or error messages during the configuration process.
